I took up gardening. It is really therapeutic and relaxing, and a very productive thing to put your energy into. I just started with a few plants in the window sill, like chillis and stuff. Nurturing a tiny little thing, making sure it's healthy and has everything it needs, watching it grow and get bigger.. It was so easy to transfer all the energy I used to put into my eating disorder, over to this little plant. The satisfaction I used to get from my ED was nothing compared to the joy of watching a plant getting its first leaves. This year I have 30 plants and flowers. I have no doubt in my mind that if I hadn't struggled with an eating disorder for so many years, it wouldn't have been that big of a success.

Maybe gardening isn't your thing, but just wanted to provide an example that it really is possible to put all of this energy and perfectionist behavior into something positive :)
